_comment: NSE trading holidays, equity segment. Spec section 10 says 19 scheduled in 2026 excluding weekends, but does NOT list the dates - so they are NOT filled in here. Inventing an exchange calendar from memory would silently mis-date results.
_how_to_fill: Copy from the official NSE holiday list (nseindia.com > Resources > Exchange Communication > Holidays) or Zerodha's published calendar. Add each as YYYY-MM-DD. Refresh once a year (spec section 10).
